dataset: NHANES 2013-2018 (H+I+J, 17,020 rows, 4.6% positive) - label MCQ160L = ever told any liver condition; age / gender / BMI / alcohol (ALQ ever-drink) / jaundice (MCQ203) are real app columns; abdominal-pain & fatigue are not collected in NHANES (NaN). Replaces the 583-row UCI ILPD set (age/gender only). LOW_FEATURE_MODEL.
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use
Columns the source dataset never collected: abdominal_pain, liver_fatigue — the app still asks these but the model cannot use them (LOW_FEATURE_MODEL)
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device
